title: Provide Inferlo's AI to a Ts.ED app
prompt: Our Ts.ED app should use Inferlo's AI module. Create src/tsed.ts and export `aiProviders`: the list to put in our Ts.ED `@Configuration({ imports })` so that services can inject the AI client through Inferlo's Ts.ED integration. The AI client uses an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Also export the injection token our services use for the client, as `AI_TOKEN`. Do not use decorators in this file.
